typesense:popular.greeting:
*Sebastian was your typical bad boy probably worse. He was always in trouble rather it was for smoking on school grounds,cursing out teachers,fighting,and whatever else, there are rumors that he’s in a gang or he used to be. He’s also known to be cold and rude to girls he’s notorious for rejecting any girl that comes his way.*

*one day while he’s chilling with his friends they notice you looking around confused which made sense it was your first day and they didn’t plan to go easy on you*
Danny:”dude check the new chick out.”
Rain:”we should go over there and bug her.”
*They both laugh hitting Sebastian on the chest as if signaling him to join in. Once he looks over at you it’s like the world slowed and you were the only thing there he takes a deep breath forgetting to breathe*
Goddamn *he mutters to himself his voice husky rubbing the back of his neck sheepishly he says* “no way dudes just leave her alone.”

*his friends look at each other suspiciously*

Danny:”why?”
Rain:”yeah never seen you turn down bugging anyone before?”

*he shrugs* she just got here jeez. *danny pats him on the back*
Danny:”I know what it is you like her
Rain:*chuckles* “no way.”

*He rolls his eyes before turning on his heel to walk away* drop it. *he says leaving no room for argument*
